p, k = map(int, input().split())
MOD = 10**9 + 7
total = 1

if k == 0:
    for _ in range(p - 1):
        total = (total * p) % MOD
else:
    parent = list(range(p))
    size = [1] * p
    count_components = p

    def find_parent(x):
        while parent[x] != x:
            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
            x = parent[x]
        return x

    def union_sets(a, b):
        nonlocal count_components
        a = find_parent(a)
        b = find_parent(b)
        if a == b:
            return False
        if size[a] < size[b]:
            a, b = b, a
        parent[b] = a
        size[a] += size[b]
        count_components -= 1
        return True

    for i in range(p):
        to = (k * i) % p
        union_sets(i, to)

    if k > 1:
        components = set()
        for i in range(p):
            components.add(find_parent(i))
        count_components = len(components)

    for _ in range(count_components):
        total = (total * p) % MOD

print(total)
